statusDefinitions.verified: Exact recorded SHA has complete automated and deployed evidence.
statusDefinitions.partial: Implementation exists but required contract or deployed proof is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.blocked: The user promise cannot be truthfully released.
statusDefinitions.deprecated: No new callers are allowed and a replacement/removal gate is recorded.

entries.name: Authenticated account
entries.userPromise: Sign-in, recovery, refresh, and reauthentication preserve the user's durable account, rating band, training preferences, timezone, and progress.
persistence: Validated IANA timezone and owned training preferences
entries.fallback: No authenticated route may persist to local-demo identity.
blockers: Profile, username, rating-band, goal, training-mode, and timezone persistence are implemented, but exact-SHA browser recovery, uniqueness, preference persistence, and reauthentication evidence is not recorded.

entries.name: Onboarding
entries.userPromise: Onboarding owns starter repertoire selection and persists completion without being overwritten by defaults.
entries.fallback: Defaults initialize only a genuinely new account.
blockers: Exact-SHA returning-user browser proof is not recorded.

entries.name: Guided opening runtime
entries.userPromise: Guided opening replies come from the canonical versioned opening runtime.
entries.fallback: Missing runtime content is unavailable; it is not silently replaced by Maia or random moves.
blockers: The selected-line completion and reply-copy regressions are covered locally; a full exact-SHA training journey remains to be recorded.

entries.name: Maia continuation opponent
entries.userPromise: Continuation play labelled Maia invokes an authenticated remote production Maia authority for the exact live position, skill level, and legal move set.
entries.fallback: Show Maia unavailable and play no substitute opponent move when remote authentication, exact-frame validation, or legal-move validation fails; never label Stockfish, runtime, random, fixture, or generic cached moves as Maia.
blockers: The standalone authenticated service, pinned model manifest, exact legal-set enforcement, and provenance validation are implemented but have not yet passed an immutable Cloud Run container build and exact-SHA staging journey.
Commercial redistribution approval or explicit maintainer confirmation for the Maia v1 weight assets must be recorded before a public production release.

entries.name: Rewards and idempotency
entries.userPromise: A legitimate completion awards the documented points and XP exactly once to the authenticated user; Rewards v2 remains unavailable until its server writer and presentation reader are independently enabled.
entries.fallback: Persistence failure is visible and awards nothing locally; an absent, false, or mismatched v2 flag keeps the v2 writer and presentation reader unavailable.
blockers: Validated account timezone and immediate presentation refresh are implemented; independent exact-SHA before/after database and visible-presentation proof for all three daily activities is incomplete.

entries.name: Daily rings
entries.userPromise: Tempo, Battery, and Daily Blundr update only their corresponding ring after product-defined completion.
entries.fallback: Failed, stale, abandoned, or partial attempts fill no ring.
blockers: Exact-SHA visible UI plus durable database isolation evidence is incomplete.

entries.name: Review and SRS
entries.userPromise: Learning acknowledgement/outbox, canonical FSRS scheduling, and Mastery/weakness projections are durable, truthful, and never manufactured from telemetry or failed writes.
authority: future server learning acknowledgement/outbox and FSRS projection authority
persistence: future immutable learning evidence, FSRS state, Mastery, and weakness projections
entries.fallback: Unavailable acknowledgement, projection, or persistence is visible and prevents a durable completion rather than writing local authenticated state or showing data as unseen.
blockers: The durable learning acknowledgement/outbox, canonical FSRS scheduler, and truthful Mastery/weakness projection authority are not implemented.
The Review Queue inbox is read-only; lifecycle changes depend on projection writers and are not mutated by the client.
Complete deployed review-to-progress evidence is not recorded.

entries.name: Production Daily reservation
entries.userPromise: Daily Blundr reserves and commits a server-owned production deck only when its current Daily, learning, storage, and opening-access authorities are enabled; the obsolete adaptive experiment flag does not gate production Daily.
persistence: Server-owned Daily reservations, actions, learning evidence, and terminal reward evidence
entries.fallback: A missing current authority flag returns one shared unavailable capability to Review and Daily; failed or stale action writes leave the reserved deck unchanged and return a safe retryable error; no local, adaptive-experiment, minigame, or mixed-test substitute is enabled.
blockers: The production Daily authority requires exact-SHA disposable database proof and owner staging acceptance.

entries.name: Repertoire and seen lines
entries.userPromise: Starter openings and canonical openingId plus playKey seen-line coordinates persist across sessions.
entries.fallback: Missing opening content is explicit; user selection is not manufactured.
blockers: User-facing repertoire values are formatted at presentation boundaries; exact-SHA browser/database persistence proof is incomplete.

entries.name: Provider game imports
entries.userPromise: Live provider imports complete through an authenticated leased worker, remain attributable and deduplicated, and create weaknesses only from verified game evidence.
persistence: future idempotent import jobs and leases
entries.fallback: Provider or worker failure is reported; queued is not completion, and no sample games or weaknesses are generated.
blockers: The protected leased import worker, production cron, stale-lease recovery, and completion authority are not implemented.
Live provider QA and import-to-training evidence are incomplete.

entries.name: Procedural minigames
entries.userPromise: Enabled standalone Review minigames generate varied, legal, solvable, navigable positions and are not Adaptive Daily cards.
entries.fallback: Generator failure returns verified content unavailable; Daily does not substitute a standalone minigame.
blockers: Exact-SHA browser coverage for every enabled family is incomplete.
The legacy Daily deep-minigame flag is deprecated and disabled in release profiles; standalone Review requires its own future catalog control.

entries.name: Engine-certified deep minigames
entries.userPromise: Tactic Shots, Knight Gymnasium, and King and Pawn Lab are standalone Review minigames with unique server-owned multi-step lines and never leak answers before reveal.
entries.fallback: No placeholder line; return verified content unavailable. Adaptive Daily does not enable deep minigames.
blockers: Migration and exact-SHA browser/database proof remain required.
The original source generator was not supplied, so catalog regeneration is not reproducible.
The legacy Daily deep-minigame flag is deprecated and disabled in release profiles; standalone Review requires its own future catalog control.

entries.name: Opening runtime data
entries.userPromise: Training consumes one deterministic versioned 21-opening runtime package.
entries.fallback: Small Colle CSV exports are reference fixtures, not production replacements.
blockers: Canonical checksums and deterministic rounding manifest must be finalized in-repository.

entries.name: Observability and privacy
entries.userPromise: Critical failures, capacity limits, and release readiness are observable without leaking credentials, private data, or chess answers.
entries.fallback: Telemetry failure does not alter learning, rewards, rings, or weaknesses; missing capacity or alert proof blocks release readiness.
blockers: Capacity load tests, dashboards, alert routing, backup/PITR, and release-readiness evidence are not implemented or proven.
Alert delivery and provider/reward/minigame operational dashboards are unproven.

entries.name: Production UI shell and feature preservation
entries.userPromise: The production UI has one accessible responsive shell and preserves each mapped product feature without duplicate domain writes or hidden legacy routes.
persistence: No new persistence; preserves existing authoritative product writes
entries.fallback: Unavailable data remains explicitly unavailable; the shell never replaces authenticated product state with local or sample state.
blockers: The one-shell UI transition, feature-preservation ledger, responsive/accessibility acceptance, and route gzip budgets are not implemented or proven.

entries.name: Commercial launch presentation

persistence: Supabase Auth user metadata stores presentation-only launch plan intent; no billing tables or entitlement grants exist in this wave.
entries.fallback: Free onboarding remains available; Pro checkout is labeled unavailable and may only save intent until backend billing and entitlement authority are implemented.

entries.fallback: Do not move the stable alias or deploy Production.
blockers: The final pushed SHA has not been deployed to the isolated blundr-staging production target.
